name: Gumleaf · Gremlet #12
description:
A very fluffy koala who insists on being called Your Fluffiness.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Gumleaf in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
